Built-in My templates

Your templates

Setups you saved from the Test page. Each one keeps the target, headers, body, load settings and pass/fail targets, so next time you open it and press Start. Credentials are stored encrypted and are only ever visible to you.

To keep one of the built-in jobs, open it under Built-in and press Save a copy. Your copy is yours to change, and it stays as you left it.

Nothing saved yet

Open any job under Built-in and press Save a copy, set up a test on the Test page and press Save as template, or import a curl command, a HAR file, a Postman collection or an OpenAPI document.

Ready-made jobs for common systems. Search by system, protocol or what you want to test (wordpress, saml, redis, spike, login storm…), pick a job, and it opens on the Test page ready to run.

Save as template

Keeps this whole setup: the target, headers, body, load settings and pass/fail targets. Credentials in it are stored encrypted and are only visible to you.

Import

Paste a curl command (in your browser: Network tab, right-click a request, Copy as cURL), or the contents of a HAR file, a Postman collection or an OpenAPI / Swagger document. Nothing is sent: BLASTA only reads it.

Delete your account

This removes your account, your sign-in sessions and your whole test history. It cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want a copy.
